territorial_scope.description: Applies within the State of Ceará; micro-size projects are licensed by municipal environmental bodies where qualified.

evidence.quote: Esta Lei institui a Política Estadual de Incentivo à implantação de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia Elétrica em Baterias

summary.short: Ceará state statute (Lei 19.849/2026) creating an incentive policy for battery energy storage systems (SAEB) and data centers. It sets size-based environmental licensing stages and study requirements, allows public land allocation and ICMS tax relief subject to Confaz agreement, and imposes fire-safety and monitoring duties. Effective on publication, 16 July 2026.
summary.long: Lei 19.849 of 16 July 2026 establishes a state incentive policy for battery energy storage systems (SAEB) and data centers in Ceará. Articles 2 and 3 set environmental licensing stages by size and environmental potential: SAEB of small size use a single licence (LAU), medium and large SAEB use two stages (LP and LIO), and exceptional SAEB use three stages (LP, LI and LO); data centers of small and medium size use two stages and large and exceptional data centers use three. Article 4 and the Annex classify projects into micro, small, medium, large and exceptional bands by capacity (MWh for SAEB, MW for data centers). Article 5 assigns micro projects to municipal environmental bodies, or to Semace where none is qualified. Article 6 links the required environmental study to size. Article 7 directs Semace to issue a normative instruction, and Article 7-A requires medium-and-larger data centers to keep continuous environmental monitoring. Article 8 requires the state Fire Department to issue fire-safety technical standards. Article 9 allows state land near transmission substations to be allocated to SAEB projects through public selection. Article 10 allows ICMS deferral or exemption on equipment, conditional on Confaz agreement. Articles 11 and 12 assign coordination to the State Development Secretariat and authorise cooperation agreements with federal bodies and grid entities. Entry into force on publication.

notes: Relations and entities are coded from the text only; no target instrument is in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty. The Federal Constitution and Lei Complementar 140/2011 are cited in the Parágrafo único as the competence framework; the Act's own text does not state a repeal or amendment. Art. 11, II ends in 'locacional;e' (a typographical error in the source). Art. 7.º-A uses 'Data Centers e Centro de Processamento de Dados' (singular) in one place. The Annex gives a single potential-degradation level per table (SAEB: MÉDIO; data centres: ALTO), with Art. 4 referring to it. The Act is a state statute; the official Diário Oficial header states the text does not replace the published version.

obligations.summary: Environmental licensing of SAEB projects of small size is done in a single stage through a Licença Ambiental Única (LAU); medium and large projects in two stages (LP and LIO); exceptional projects in three stages (LP, LI and LO), per the size, location and polluting potential criteria.

evidence.quote: para o porte pequeno, o licenciamento ambiental será realizado em etapa única

obligations.summary: Environmental licensing of data centers of small and medium size is done in two stages (LP and LIO); large and exceptional data centers in three stages (LP, LI and LO).

evidence.quote: para os portes pequeno e médio, o licenciamento ambiental será realizado em 2 (duas) etapas

obligations.summary: Municipal environmental agencies license micro-size SAEB and data center projects; where no adequately qualified municipal agency exists, Semace licenses them through a Licença Ambiental Única (LAU).
obligations.conditional_on: projects classified as micro size; Semace role only where no qualified municipal agency exists

evidence.quote: serão licenciados pelos órgãos ambientais municipais competentes

obligations.summary: Micro-size projects licensed by Semace submit a Plano de Controle Ambiental (PCA), a Relatório de Controle Ambiental (RCA) and other technical elements.
obligations.conditional_on: licensing by Semace under Art. 5.º, parágrafo único

evidence.quote: com apresentação de Plano de Controle Ambiental – PCA, Relatório de Controle Ambiental – RCA

obligations.summary: Environmental study required by size and project type: for SAEB, PCA and RCA (small), EAS (medium), RAS (large and exceptional); for data centers, EAS (small and medium), RAS (large and exceptional).
obligations.conditional_on: size classification under Art. 4.º and Anexo Único

evidence.quote: porte médio: Estudo Ambiental Simplificado – EAS

obligations.summary: Semace defines the minimum content of environmental studies in a specific terms of reference, made available by Semace, taking into account size, nature, location and impact potential.

evidence.quote: será definido em termo de referência específico, disponibilizado pela Semace

obligations.summary: Semace shall issue a normative instruction (instrução normativa) governing the technical and administrative procedures for applying Arts. 2 to 6.

evidence.quote: A Semace editará instrução normativa para disciplinar os procedimentos técnicos e administrativos

obligations.summary: Data centers of medium, large and exceptional size must maintain a permanent environmental monitoring system and provide updated information on their environmental performance electronically when requested, subject to Lei Federal 12.527/2011.

evidence.quote: deverão manter sistema permanente de monitoramento ambiental

obligations.summary: The State Fire Department (Corpo de Bombeiros) shall issue a specific technical fire safety and panic standard for the covered undertakings, and ensure priority analysis of projects and inspections.

evidence.quote: O Corpo de Bombeiros do Estado editará norma técnica específica de segurança contra incêndio e pânico

obligations.summary: The Executive may allocate disused state public areas near transmission substations to SAEB implantation, by real-right concession, onerous assignment or other legal instrument, always preceded by a public selection procedure.
obligations.conditional_on: areas near Rede Básica, DIT or ICG substations; always preceded by public selection

evidence.quote: O Poder Executivo poderá, a título de subvenção econômica, destinar áreas públicas estaduais desafetadas

obligations.summary: The Executive may grant ICMS tax treatment to the covered undertakings, including deferral or exemption on acquisition of machinery and equipment for fixed assets.
obligations.conditional_on: conditioned on an agreement (convênio) being concluded or joined within Confaz

evidence.quote: O Poder Executivo poderá, na forma da legislação aplicável, conceder aos empreendimentos

obligations.summary: The Secretaria de Desenvolvimento do Estado (SDE) coordinates the Policy and shall coordinate state bodies on licensing, fire safety and area allocation, provide investors with electrical infrastructure information, and monitor deadlines assumed by state bodies toward winners of federal auctions.

evidence.quote: A Política de que trata esta Lei será coordenada pela Secretaria de Desenvolvimento do Estado – SDE

obligations.summary: The Executive may enter into agreements and cooperation arrangements with the Union, EPE, ONS, ANEEL and transmission and distribution utilities for information exchange and support for implantation.

evidence.quote: O Poder Executivo poderá celebrar convênios e acordos de cooperação com a União

enforcement.note: The text sets up environmental licensing procedures (Arts. 2-7-A), fire-safety rules (Art. 8), incentives (Arts. 9-10) and coordination duties (Art. 11), but states no fines, penalties, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension or blocking. Art. 5 para. único and Art. 7-A refer to Lei Federal 15.190/2025 and Lei Federal 12.527/2011 without stating any sanction in this text.
